formula: Hips[f] = U . E_BASE[f] . V . E_HIP[f] . W, where E_BASE is euler track 3 and E_HIP is euler track 5, decoded via applier_euler + euler_quat6 (XYZ). Only rot_xyzw['Hips'] is replaced; all other 20 joints, root_t and root_motion_fwd_m are copied verbatim from the decoded original. Spine is never touched.

This joint sandwich solves U, V, W jointly over 574 + 578 + 588 and is the ONLY sandwich future pulls may use. See game/js/t7-throw-clips.js header (JOINT SANDWICH) and the T7 throw fix PR.
